detailed_description: The HTML Table Generator enables developers to create semantically correct, responsive HTML tables through an interactive visual interface. This tool leverages client-side JavaScript to dynamically generate TABLE structures with precise control over THEAD, TBODY, TR, TH, and TD elements. Users can adjust row and column counts, define header/footer sections, and apply custom CSS classes for styling. The tool's core functionality includes automatic generation of accessibility attributes (like scope="col"), support for rowspan/colspan configurations, and built-in responsive design features using CSS Grid or Flexbox frameworks. Developers benefit from real-time code preview with syntax highlighting, allowing immediate validation of markup validity. The generated code includes optimized table-layout: fixed for better rendering performance and supports data sorting through clickable column headers. This tool addresses common pain points in manual table creation, particularly for data-heavy applications like dashboards, comparison charts, and database exports where pixel-perfect alignment and cross-browser compatibility are critical.
usage_steps: 1. Launch the tool and set initial dimensions using the row/column sliders in the Configuration Panel
2. Toggle header/footer sections using the 'Add Header' and 'Add Footer' checkboxes to define THEAD and TFOOT elements
3. Customize cell properties in the right sidebar by selecting individual TD/TH elements to apply CSS classes, text alignment, and border styles
4. Enable responsive features by activating the 'Mobile Breakpoint' slider and specifying min-width values for column visibility thresholds
5. Use the 'Sort Controls' toggle to add clickable sorting functionality to column headers with automatic arrow indicator rendering
6. Export the final output using the 'Copy Code' button or download as .html file with embedded CSS stylesheets for immediate implementation
usage_examples: 1. Creating a responsive pricing comparison table for SaaS products with sticky header rows and alternating row colors
2. Generating a database query results viewer with dynamic column sorting and customizable cell padding for enterprise dashboards
3. Building accessible data tables for government websites with automatic scope attributes and screen reader-friendly caption elements
4. Developing an e-commerce product inventory template with fixed column widths and text-overflow: ellipsis handling for long descriptions
